name: Build Editorial/Edit Graph
description: Derives the editorial/edit graph from the run's recorded decisions: one node per decision the planners made (passage selection, spine block, A-roll assignment, B-roll cover, transition, graphic, music behavior, VFX, SFX, grade correction, mix window), with dependency edges, intent links, evidence links and constraints. The graph is DERIVED, never authored - planners decide exactly as they did, and this step only emits the structure a reader queries. Runs after the planning steps and before the cohesion review and compile, so the graph exists for the readers the target behavior names. A state key the run has not produced is simply absent: the graph builds from whatever decisions exist.

inputs.name: project_folder
inputs.description: State input: project_folder. REQUIRED: the step reads pipeline_data.json from the project folder to derive the graph.

inputs.name: audio_spine
inputs.description: State input: audio_spine from step 2.05. REQUIRED: the spine is the graph's backbone - the timed structure every block, cut and overlay hangs off. Without it there is no edit to graph.

inputs.name: timed_spine
inputs.description: State input: timed_spine from step 2.05. OPTIONAL: a copy of audio_spine, read only when audio_spine is absent.

inputs.name: speech_sequence
inputs.description: State input: speech_sequence from step 2.02. OPTIONAL: its body_sequence passages become passage_selection nodes.

inputs.name: a_roll_assignments
inputs.description: State input: a_roll_assignments from step 3.01. OPTIONAL: each assignment becomes an aroll_assignment node.

inputs.name: b_roll_assignments
inputs.description: State input: b_roll_assignments from step 3.02. OPTIONAL: each assignment becomes a broll_cover node.

inputs.name: b_roll_interjections
inputs.description: State input: b_roll_interjections from step 3.02. OPTIONAL: each interjection becomes a broll_cover node.

inputs.name: transition_spec
inputs.description: State input: transition_spec from step 4.02. OPTIONAL: each transition becomes a transition node.

inputs.name: subtitle_overlay
inputs.description: State input: subtitle_overlay from step 4.05. OPTIONAL: each rendered segment becomes a graphic node.

inputs.name: motion_graphics_overlay
inputs.description: State input: motion_graphics_overlay from step 4.06. OPTIONAL: each rendered segment becomes a graphic node.

inputs.name: enhancement_spec
inputs.description: State input: enhancement_spec from step 4.03. OPTIONAL: each entry becomes a vfx node.

inputs.name: sfx_spec
inputs.description: State input: sfx_spec from step 4.04. OPTIONAL: each entry becomes an sfx node.

inputs.name: color_grade_spec
inputs.description: State input: color_grade_spec from step 5.01. OPTIONAL: each subject_grades entry becomes a grade_correction node.

inputs.name: audio_mix_spec
inputs.description: State input: audio_mix_spec from step 5.02. OPTIONAL: each mix_windows entry becomes a mix_window node.

inputs.name: music_selection
inputs.description: State input: music_selection from step 2.04. OPTIONAL: the chosen tracks the music_behavior words were decided against.

inputs.name: music_analysis
inputs.description: State input: music_analysis from step 2.06. OPTIONAL: the measured tempo and beat grid the music_behavior words rest on.

inputs.name: creative_direction
inputs.description: State input: creative_direction from step 2.01. OPTIONAL: the narrative intent the graph's intent links point at.

inputs.name: clip_catalog
inputs.description: State input: clip_catalog from step 1.02. OPTIONAL: the clip identities the evidence links cite.

inputs.name: semantic_analysis_documents
inputs.description: State input: semantic_analysis_documents from step 1.03. OPTIONAL: the per-clip vision documents the B-roll evidence links cite.

outputs.name: edit_graph
outputs.description: State output: the derived editorial/edit graph - nodes, dependency edges, intent links, evidence links and constraints. Validated against library/schema/edit_graph.schema.json.
